job.description:
Provalus, part of the OPS brand, is changing the landscape in the technology solutions industry with our innovative go-to-market strategies. Provalus hires and develops the best and brightest talent in rural America to deliver technology and support services for Fortune 1000 companies.

job.title: IT Systems Administrator
job.description:
Role Overview

Provalus is seeking an experienced IT Systems Administrator to join our team. This is an internal SGA position open to qualified candidates at any Provalus site location.

This is an in-office, on-site role and is not a remote position. The regular work schedule is Monday through Friday during normal business hours. The Systems Administrator will also participate in the team's on-call rotation, approximately one week per month.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of enterprise technology and hands-on experience supporting cloud platforms, enterprise desktop environments, and IT infrastructure. This role will provide systems administration and advanced technical support across Provalus operations, including our rural technology centers.

  • Manage mobile devices and endpoints using Microsoft Intune
  • Support and administer Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) tools
  • Manage operating system and application patching
  • Support OS imaging and deployment
  • Provide Level 3 technical support and escalation assistance for the IT Support Desk
  • Develop and maintain scripts using PowerShell and/or Python
  • Create and maintain clear technical documentation, including diagrams using Lucidchart
  • Troubleshoot complex systems, endpoint, application, and infrastructure issues
  • Participate in the team's rotating on-call schedule, approximately one week per month

  • Strong understanding of networking protocols and technologies
  • Experience supporting enterprise IT systems and infrastructure
  • Working knowledge of Azure, Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory, and endpoint management
  • Intermediate knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell and/or Python
  • Familiarity with hardware and transmission technologies, including cabling, WAN, and transport technologies
  • Ability to understand business use cases and translate requirements into effective technical solutions
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills
  • Understanding of how IT technology supports enterprise operations and business functions
  • Ability to adapt as technology, business needs, and organizational requirements evolve
  • Ability to participate in scheduled on-call coverage and provide after-hours support when required

Preferred / Plus Skills

Experience in any of the following areas is a plus:

  • Microsoft licensing
  • Power BI

Job Summary
The Delivery Director provides strategic and operational leadership for multiple client accounts and service delivery teams. This role is responsible for ensuring successful client outcomes, maintaining operational excellence, and driving employee engagement across the site. The Delivery Director oversees Team Leads and Operational Managers supporting client programs consisting of help desk and customer service agents.
In addition to client delivery responsibilities, this position serves as a key site leader, partnering closely with Facilities, Human Resources, Recruiting, Training, Sales and Executive Leadership to ensure a positive employee experience, operational efficiency, and continued growth of the organization. The ideal candidate is a relationship-focused leader with strong business acumen, exceptional communication skills, and experience managing large-scale contact center or technology support operations.
Key Responsibilities
Client Delivery & Relationship Management

  • Own overall service delivery, operational performance, and client satisfaction across multiple client accounts.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, serving as the primary escalation point and strategic partner.
  • Develop content and lead regular business reviews (MBR, QBR, ABR), operational updates, and performance discussions with clients.
  • Ensure contract deliverables, service level agreements (SLAs), quality standards, and operational KPIs are consistently achieved.
  • Identify opportunities for account growth, process improvements, and expanded services.
  • Manage client escalations and develop action plans to resolve issues quickly and effectively.

Operational Leadership

  • Mentor future leadership to build strong leaders of people, setting goals to help others achieve the career aspirations they desire.
  • Establish performance expectations and accountability measures across all programs.
  • Analyze operational metrics, workforce trends, quality scores, customer satisfaction, productivity, and financial performance.
  • P&L Ownership and Accountability in regards to team sizes, structures, schedules, etc.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve service delivery, operational efficiency, and customer experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Operations Management, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
  • 8+ years of operational leadership experience with at least 3-5 years managing managers or multi-layer leadership teams.
  • Experience overseeing large customer service, contact center, help desk, technical support, or IT service delivery operations.
  • Proven success managing client relationships and executive stakeholder communications.
  • Strong experience leading large teams across multiple programs and service lines.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage operational KPIs, service levels, workforce planning, and business performance.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
